annotations.title: Add a number to a 10DLC campaign

description: Put one of the brand's numbers under an approved 10DLC campaign: on Twilio by adding it to the campaign's Messaging Service (messagingServiceSid), on Telnyx by campaignId. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
